visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair tied in a bun wears a tan sports bra and cream-colored leggings while performing triceps pushdown exercises at a professional gym cable machine. She grips the V-bar attachment with both hands, pulling it downward with controlled motion while maintaining a slight forward lean. (2) The camera angle shifts to a rear view of the woman as she performs standing cable flyes, focusing on her upper back and shoulder muscles. The setting is a brightly lit indoor fitness facility with various weight machines and exercise equipment visible in the background. (3) The scene cuts to the woman standing next to a rack of dumbbells near a window, performing alternating bicep curls with a single dumbbell. Her form is steady as she lifts the weight toward her shoulder, highlighting her arm definition under soft indoor lighting. (4) From a low rear angle, the woman is seen performing wide-grip pull-ups or lat pulldowns on a power rack labeled with the words 'NO FEAR FITNESS.' The gym environment appears clean and modern with silver and black metal equipment throughout the space. (5) The final phase shows a mirror selfie sequence where the woman poses to display her muscular physique. She holds a smartphone to capture her reflection, flexing her right arm to show bicep definition while wearing a smartwatch and jewelry on her wrist.
